initialization: raw reference frame zero and canonical finite-difference velocities
reference_velocity: centered generalized-position difference at plus/minus one source interval; one-sided at endpoints

failure.comparison: strict greater-than; absolute world-z error and absolute projected unit-gravity z difference in robot/reference root frames; no end-effector termination

scoring_time: post-physics state at same reference timestamp, including exact final source timestamp

position_alignment_definition.no_alignment: raw world positions; no fitted or initial transform
position_alignment_definition.xy: subtract each actual/reference pelvis XY; keep absolute world Z and orientation
position_alignment_definition.xy_yaw: XY centering followed by closest world-Z rotation from actual to reference pelvis orientation; preserve Z and tilt
position_alignment_definition.yaw_rule: M=R_ref*R_actual^T; angle=atan2(M[1,0]-M[0,1],M[0,0]+M[1,1]); ambiguity if hypot of atan2 arguments <=1e-12; use angle=0, retain sample and expose fraction
position_alignment_definition.aggregation: Mean Euclidean distance across 14 body origins, then mean over metric samples through the exact endpoint; macro mean across clips.

allowed: joint positions and velocities in named order
gravity projection and local pose FK
frozen reference poses and reference velocities
forbidden: actual global root or body position
actual root or body linear velocity in any frame
position or linear-velocity estimates derived explicitly from sensors/history
contact measurements and privileged dynamics state
observation_rules.reference_rule: Reference positions and velocities are permitted; measured robot translation or linear velocity cannot align or modify them.
observation_rules.admission: Exact checkpoint input audit, author-inference parity, batch conversion parity and fresh full-suite evaluation. Required forbidden inputs cannot be replaced with arbitrary zero values.

reference_kinematics: Core precomputes private scoring targets with MuJoCo/MJWarp before rollout at the scoring clock and exact motion endpoints. Adapters receive root/joint references and maintain their own reference body features.
